India’s Largest Treasure of Manuscripts | Khuda Bakhsh Oriental Public Library, Patna
Discover one of India’s most remarkable centers of knowledge and heritage — the Khuda Bakhsh Oriental Public Library in Patna, Bihar.
Located on the banks of the Ganges River, this historic library was opened to the public in October 1891 by Khan Bahadur Khuda Bakhsh. What began with a collection of 4,000 rare manuscripts has grown into one of the world’s most significant repositories of Islamic, Persian, Arabic, and South Asian literary heritage.
